# Ochrecut

> Ochrecut (planned App Store name "Ochrecut: Pour & Dig Puzzle") is a calm puzzle game for iPhone (iOS 15 or later). Dig clay cells in a hillside cross-section so mineral pigment (ochre, cinnabar, lapis) pours like sand into matching glazed pots. Coming soon to the App Store; not yet available.

- Controls: tap a clay cell to dig it; each tap costs one pick. Pigment falls like sand, settles grain by grain and slides off ledges. Fill every pot with its own colour before the picks run out; a grain of the wrong colour muddies a pot. Each level has a par for three stars.
- From chapter 2, two primaries meet in a stone mortar and are ground into a mix: verdigris, saffron or murex, for the pots that want one.
- 90 levels in three chapters: The Clay Pit (30 levels, included free), The Mill and The Deep Seam (60 more with All Mills, a one-time purchase).
- Tools: Undo (takes back the last dig), Extra Picks (adds three picks), Hint (marks a good cell). Optional tool packs: Tool Pouch and Tool Crate. Restore Purchases is in Settings.
- No timer, no lives, no ads, no account, no analytics or tracking. Progress stays on the device and the game plays offline; only purchases talk to the App Store. English only.
